claims: As of April 2026, Rory McIlroy has won six major championships.
Rory McIlroy completed the career Grand Slam with back-to-back Masters victories in 2025 and 2026.
Rory McIlroy won the Masters in 2025.
Rory McIlroy won the Masters in 2026.
Rory McIlroy won the PGA Championship in 2012.
Rory McIlroy won the PGA Championship in 2014.
Rory McIlroy won the U.S. Open in 2011.
Rory McIlroy won the Open Championship in 2014.
